features.title: Native Settings shell, ported
features.summary: The sidebar Settings trigger, connection recovery pill, Desktop update indicator, General section, onboarding coordinator and Mod+, shortcut of the native Settings shell, served by this bundle with the native row switched off.
failureModes: When the running DSH ships another version of the native Settings package, the Host warns at boot and General shows it, so the port is refreshed instead of drifting silently.
The native welcome notice stores its acknowledgement in the switched-off row's namespace; the step is skipped while that namespace is unserved.

verification.testName: matches the native Settings package this workspace builds against
